"Honestly Im kinda ok with it. Theres not a more perfect way for a paleontologist to go than being disemboweled by raptors. Im glad I wrote all this down. Im glad I stayed sane, Im glad I got to see dinosaurs and Im honored to die doing what I love, looking at dinosaurs."

"Well. I submit my final entry. I thought the dinosaurs slept at night, so I snuck out to get some supplies. I was wrong. They had one watching me. They locked me out of the control center. Its only a matter of time now. Guess I wont have to live with the guilt of survival."

"The fans turned off for a bit, and I almost lost it completely, but the weight of Mary Anns crinoid calmed me down. Apparently some of those little coelophysis  had chewed through the extension cord, so I just replaced it with one from the now non functioning computers."
"I cant with these raptors. Theyre like fucking paranoia machines, manufacturing my fear. I cant fucking take this."

"[DAY 3]   I decided to try to lure the raptors from the control center with some of the random fridge food, but apparently the only thing they want is me. And now Ive wasted food. Not a great start to the morning. I feel like the control center is one incident away from falling."

"Its time for bed again and I feel like Im breaking. My days are so filled with disaster and heartbreak, I finally got the communications online but I have to wonder if it was worth it, if Ill even survive until then. No one even answered my comms today."
"crying now. Youd think the countless deaths would do that, but its this fucking stench. I hope rescue comes soon."

"I walked over to the east side of the building and the iguanodon the raptors killed has apparently just been rotting away. The stench is worked into the vents and I expect the whole building will smell like rotting dinosaur soon. Idk why this pushed me over the edge, but Im"
"Apparently I cant have too many good hours in a row, cuz I just disabled the fucking computers with a virus fucking Martin had been working on. Fuck you, martin."

"I dont know what I did but apparently that cutting wires last night diverted enough power for me to boot up the communications system! Im going to be saved, if i dont die first. Things here at the control center seem shaky but hopefully I can make it long enough. Wish me luck."
"[DAY 2]  The alarms kept waking me up last night, and in my exhausted stupor I ended up cutting the wires to shut them up. Im even more terrified and paranoid now. God this sucks."
"Its almost time to sleep, which I am grateful and terrified for. The memories are heavy today and so is my heart. I wish I had more agency in my situation. I must keep going. I wish I knew why"

"While I was searching through peoples stuff earlier, I found the crinoid fossil Mary Ann, one of the other interns, always kept with her. Her first fossil find, she has told me. She kept it with her for luck. I guess I better test if its true"
"Fuck. Pterosaurs have made a home on the helicopter landing pad. Getting rescued is gonna be even more challenging."

"I keep feeling like I see Dr. Alexis, even though I know it isnt her. I am alone at this park. I feel like I cant focus, I was never in charge here, but she told me what to do. Maybe its comforting me to see her, but the reality is that she is gone, just like the rest."

"In my boredom Ive collected the artifacts of those who have worked here, counted the people and the animals who will miss their family. Will I have to be the one to tell them? Why am I still here? Who would miss me if I befell the same fate as everyone else. God. I have to stop."

"Why am I the last survivor? Why do I have to be the one who saw what it looks like when raptors kill a human. Why cant my mind erase what it looks like when a human is smashed with an ankylosaur club? Why did this building only have 1 TV.   I miss watching the land before time."

"Until now Ive been staving off boredom and guilt with the expansive collection of dinosaur media available. Walking with Dinosaurs had become my comfort show. But now there is silence and a broken TV and my brain can only replay the countless deaths Ive seen."

"I will survive for as long as I can and try to send out a distress call. I am posting this log to Twitter in the hopes that someone will find it, or it will post despite having no connectivity here in the park. My mentor is dead. Everyone is dead. I am the last survivor."

"Its been one day since the incident. I am Darwin Cope, paleontology intern for DinoLand experiences, Inc. I am the last survivor in the park. I have secured myself in the control center but Im being pursued by a pack of raptors. They seem to be hunting me specifically."
